review_notes: I read the whole file and the Mathlib lemmas it uses: contMDiffAt_subtype_iff, liftPropWithinAt_subtypeVal_comp_iff, contMDiffOn_chart and contMDiffOn_chart_symm. I also checked Mathlib's ContMDiff.subtypeVal_comp_iff. It is stated only for regularity ∞, so it can't replace the argument here, where n : ℕ∞ω. The rest of the file (chartBall, the ChartLocalBall structure, the himage proof) has no second use of the same reasoning. The proposed helper has not been compiled. Its hypotheses are written to match the actual use sites, but implicit-argument elaboration, for example of the model-with-corners arguments, may need adjustment.

findings.problem: hsmooth and hsmooth_symm are the same ~18-line argument with two different inputs. Each one (1) gets ContMDiffAt of the underlying map (chart, or chart.symm) at a point from contMDiffOn_chart or contMDiffOn_chart_symm plus an open-neighbourhood fact; (2) restricts it to the subtype with contMDiffAt_subtype_iff; (3) rewrites Subtype.val ∘ homeo (or homeo.symm) to that restriction with `convert ... using 1; funext; rfl`; and (4) transfers smoothness from Subtype.val ∘ g to g with an inline `show ... from ChartedSpace.liftPropWithinAt_subtypeVal_comp_iff ..`. Mathlib's ready-made ContMDiff.subtypeVal_comp_iff only covers regularity ∞, which is why step (4) was written out by hand for general n : ℕ∞ω. As it stands, a change to this argument has to be made twice, and the long repeated ContMDiffAt type ascriptions bury the one mathematical fact each proof needs.
findings.proposed_change:
Add one private lemma in the ChartedSpace namespace, before chartLocalBall, with the same universe and typeclass variables plus a second charted space:

private theorem contMDiff_codRestrict_opens {N : Type*} [TopologicalSpace N] [ChartedSpace E N] {M' : Type*} [TopologicalSpace M'] [ChartedSpace E M'] {n : ℕ∞ω} {U : Opens N} {V : Opens M'} {f : N → M'} {g : U → V} (hg : ∀ p, (g p : M') = f p) (hf : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(𝕜, E) 𝓘(𝕜, E) n f U) : ContMDiff 𝓘(𝕜, E) 𝓘(𝕜, E) n g

Proof sketch: `intro p`. Take `hf p.1 p.2` and apply `.contMDiffAt (U.isOpen.mem_nhds p.2)` to get `ContMDiffAt n f p.1`. Apply `contMDiffAt_subtype_iff.mpr` to get `ContMDiffAt n (fun q : U => f q) p`. Rewrite `Subtype.val ∘ g = fun q : U => f q` by `funext q; exact hg q`. Finish with `(ChartedSpace.liftPropWithinAt_subtypeVal_comp_iff g Set.univ p).mp`, exactly as in the current code.

Then in chartLocalBall:
`have hsmooth : ContMDiff 𝓘(𝕜, E) 𝓘(𝕜, E) n homeo := contMDiff_codRestrict_opens (f := chart) (fun _ => rfl) ((contMDiffOn_chart (I := 𝓘(𝕜, E)) (x := x)).mono hsource)`
`have hsmooth_symm : ContMDiff 𝓘(𝕜, E) 𝓘(𝕜, E) n homeo.symm := contMDiff_codRestrict_opens (f := chart.symm) (fun _ => rfl) ((contMDiffOn_chart_symm (I := 𝓘(𝕜, E)) (x := x)).mono hball_subset)`

The first use has N = M, U = neighborhood, V = ball, and the second has N = E, U = ball, V = neighborhood. The `hg` arguments are `rfl`, as the current `funext _; rfl` steps show. The `.mono` calls replace the explicit `contMDiffAt` plus `mem_nhds` plumbing, since the helper supplies the openness of U itself. The same hypotheses are used as before (IsManifold 𝓘(𝕜,E) n M), and no new imports are needed.
findings.benefit: Each smoothness fact shrinks to a single line that names its real input, chart smoothness on the source subset for hsmooth and chart.symm smoothness on the target subset for hsmooth_symm. The restrict-to-subtype and codomain-transfer argument for general n : ℕ∞ω is stated and proved once and could be reused by other open-subset coordinate constructions. The long duplicated ContMDiffAt type ascriptions go away, and a Mathlib change to these lemmas needs one fix instead of two.
